_comment: smFRET: one panel per window. frame.py draws each panel (found by title) in its own docked window with emtk.view_form; the model is smfretweb.app.session.Session. Every field and button has a description: it is the control's tooltip (tests/test_app.py checks).

sections.label: Mode
sections.description: Simple: detection, burst search and the quality check with defaults. Advanced: also the channel, burst-search and correction settings, the time trace and the burst table in ndX.

buttons.label: Analyse
buttons.description: Run the burst search and the quality check again with the current settings.

buttons.label: Help
buttons.description: What the page does, every check and setting, and how to read the plots.

buttons.label: Guide
buttons.description: A step-by-step tour: open data, read the quality verdict, look at E/S, go further in advanced mode.

buttons.label: Bursts (.csv)
buttons.description: Download the burst table (ChiSurf .bur column names, QC flags included). ndX and ChiSurf open it.

buttons.label: QC report (.json)
buttons.description: Download the detected experiment, the settings and every quality check as JSON.

sections.label: Example
sections.description: A simulated measurement (tttrlib's photon simulator): cw, PIE or µsALEX, with or without polarization, noise channels, one colour.

buttons.label: Simulate
buttons.description: Simulate the chosen example (5 s of data, a second or two) and analyse it like a file.

sections.label: Progress
sections.description: How far the analysis has come. It runs in the background: the page stays responsive.

buttons.label: Cancel
buttons.description: Stop the running analysis. The results shown before stay.

sections.label: Excitation
sections.description: Detected from the data: alternating when a micro-time (PIE) or macro-time (µsALEX) window leaves the donor detectors dark.

sections.label: Donor
sections.description: Routing channels of the donor detectors, comma separated; with polarization: parallel first, then perpendicular.

sections.label: Acceptor
sections.description: Routing channels of the acceptor detectors, comma separated; with polarization: parallel first, then perpendicular.

sections.label: Dex window
sections.description: Donor-excitation window, 'start-stop' in micro-time channels (for µsALEX: in alternation-phase ticks).

sections.label: Aex window
sections.description: Acceptor-excitation window, 'start-stop' in micro-time channels (for µsALEX: in alternation-phase ticks).

buttons.label: Apply
buttons.description: Analyse again with these channels and windows.

buttons.label: Re-detect
buttons.description: Forget the edits and detect channels and excitation again from the photons.

sections.label: Min photons
sections.description: Bursts with fewer photons are dropped.

sections.label: m photons
sections.description: All-photon sliding window: m consecutive photons ...

sections.label: within T
sections.description: ... arriving within T microseconds belong to a burst.

sections.label: 2CDE τ
sections.description: Kernel width of FRET-2CDE and ALEX-2CDE.

sections.label: V_eff
sections.description: Effective observation volume, for the concentration estimate only (from FCS or a dye standard).

buttons.label: Apply
buttons.description: Search bursts again with these settings.

sections.label: Auto-calibrate
sections.description: ALEX/PIE: all factors from the measurement (tttrlib.auto_calibrate). cw: the leakage α from the donor-only bursts; γ, β and δ need a reference and stay as typed.

sections.label: γ
sections.description: Detection-efficiency and quantum-yield ratio of acceptor to donor.

sections.label: α (leakage)
sections.description: Donor emission leaking into the acceptor detectors.

sections.label: δ (dir. exc.)
sections.description: Direct excitation of the acceptor by the donor laser.

sections.label: β
sections.description: Excitation-intensity and cross-section ratio of the two lasers (ALEX/PIE).

sections.label: Drop QC-flagged bursts
sections.description: Leave bursts flagged bright, long or by 2CDE out of the E/S plots and of ndX.

buttons.label: Apply
buttons.description: Correct E and S again with these factors.

sections.label: From
sections.description: Start of the 10 s stretch of the trace shown below; drag or zoom the plot itself for detail.
